I’m in. I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the entire $15,000 directly to the clinic before the deadline. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the village that depends on it.

I also commit to a maximum of 6 tons next month, then 10 tons monthly once the lake returns to capacity, with all catches public. That completes the four donations totaling $60,000. Luke, please confirm your zero catch today and the same recovery limits so we have everyone’s commitment recorded before fishing.
